textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 science · The Wonderful World of Science · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Science is a way of finding out how the world works by asking questions, observing, testing and thinking. Science is not only in laboratories.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Science is a way of finding out how the world works by asking questions, observing, testing and thinking. Science is not only in laboratories. It is in the kitchen, the garden, the playground and the sky.
beats.speakEn: Science is a way of finding out how the world works by asking questions, observing, testing and thinking. Science is not only in laboratories. It is in the kitchen, the garden, the playground and the sky.

beats.en: Curiosity means wanting to know. A curious mind asks what, how and why. A good question can be tested. Why does this plant grow towards the window is a good question to investigate.
beats.speakEn: Curiosity means wanting to know. A curious mind asks what, how and why. A good question can be tested. Why does this plant grow towards the window is a good question to investigate.

type: Key Concept: Science is a way of finding out how the world works by asking questions, observing, testing
Rule: Curiosity means wanting to know. A curious mind asks what, how and why.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 science · The Wonderful World of Science · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Scientists follow steps: observe, ask a question, make a guess called a hypothesis, test it by an experiment, record results and draw a conclusion. An experiment must be fair.

beats.en: Scientists follow steps: observe, ask a question, make a guess called a hypothesis, test it by an experiment, record results and draw a conclusion. An experiment must be fair.
beats.speakEn: Scientists follow steps: observe, ask a question, make a guess called a hypothesis, test it by an experiment, record results and draw a conclusion. An experiment must be fair.

beats.en: Science helps us make medicines, grow more food, build bridges and send rockets to space. Science also asks us to be careful: always follow safety rules and respect living things and the environment.
